section: Learning algorithm; World model learning; Critic/Actor learning
request: 根据 Zotero 内 DreamerV3 附件方法正文生成世界模型学习、潜空间想象和 actor-critic 学习机制图。仅生成 PNG，后验比较 Figure 3。
context: DreamerV3 world model is an RSSM. h_t=f_phi(h_(t-1),z_(t-1),a_(t-1)); posterior z_t~q_phi(z_t|h_t,x_t) from real sensory inputs during model learning; prior zhat_t~p_phi(zhat_t|h_t). The model state s_t=(h_t,z_t) predicts reconstructed observation xhat_t, reward rhat_t, and continuation chat_t. Posterior/prior matching is trained with KL-based dynamics and representation losses. Actor and critic learn from latent trajectories imagined using the learned model, starting from representations of replayed inputs. In imagination use the prior for future stochastic states, not fresh real observations or an encoder at each future step. Actor draws a_t~pi_theta(a_t|s_t); state transitions use the action, recurrent state, and prior-sampled stochastic representation. Model supplies predicted rewards and continuation flags; critic supplies predicted values, with bootstrapped lambda returns used for actor/critic learning. Do not conflate imagined learning with MPC/CEM: environment actions are sampled directly from actor without lookahead planning. World-model reconstruction is a training objective, not necessary pixel decoding at every imagined step. Keep real replay-driven learning and imagined latent learning visually separate; no performance numbers or invented Minecraft frames. Scope is the core mechanism, not complete robustness loss design.
principles: DB241: recurrent temporal chain and separate observed/posterior versus prior-predicted stochastic states. Do not import event segmentation or reproduce its figure topology. Two distinct learning regions are composed independently.
